messages:
nina: Quick one - someone reported the Offline Installer guide doesn't show a compact example for KMS transport config for air-gapped installs. Also a few links to the network port matrix are stale. Can we patch and add a tiny YAML + curl checksum example?

omar: I can fix the links. The port matrix moved under /network/ports -> /network/port-reference. I'll add a redirect note and anchor alias.

lee: For the quick example, propose this minimal YAML block for the installer:
```yaml
# kms config for sealed installs
kms:
  transport: unix  # options: unix | tcp
  socket_path: /var/run/kms.sock
  tls: false
```
And a single-line curl to verify the offline bundle checksum: `curl -sS https://downloads.redwood.ai/bundles/redwood-offline.sha256 | grep redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz`

nina: Also add a short troubleshooting note: "If installer fails to reach KMS over unix socket, check systemd unit creates socket with correct ownership (example: `chown redwood-installer:installer /var/run/pkcs11.sock && chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock`)."

omar: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/820 - adds YAML snippet, checksum one-liner, and anchor aliases.

docbot: link-checker: 2 broken links detected in /offline/installer.md - addressed in PR 820.

lee: Small editorial: call out when to use `tcp` (managed KMS or remote HSM) vs `unix` (local PKCS11 daemon in sealed sites). One sentence each.

omar: Added that and ran docs lint. CI flagged a trailing slash in internal link, fixed.

nina: Preview URL?

docbot: netlify-preview: https://deploy-preview-820--docs.redwood.ai

nina: Preview looks good, examples render and anchor aliases work. Merging now.

omar: Merged. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
